target.definition: The headline monthly total of registered company insolvencies in England and Wales for August 2026 (compulsory liquidations, creditors' voluntary liquidations, administrations, company voluntary arrangements and receivership appointments, with the first three seasonally adjusted), as first reported in the Insolvency Service's monthly Company Insolvency Statistics release.

inputs.name: annual_company_insolvencies_2026
inputs.description: Total registered company insolvencies in England and Wales during calendar year 2026

provenance.rationale: Recent annual totals were about 25,000 in 2023 and roughly 23,000-24,000 in 2024-25; a mild easing is assumed for 2026.

inputs.name: months_per_year
inputs.description: Number of months in a year, used to convert an annual total to a monthly average

inputs.name: august_length
inputs.description: Length of the reporting month, converting a monthly average rate into a count for August

provenance.rationale: The month is exactly one month long.

inputs.name: august_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Factor by which August's seasonally adjusted headline total differs from the annual monthly average

provenance.rationale: The main components are seasonally adjusted, so the August headline should sit close to the average monthly level, with modest residual variation.

inputs.name: cvl_count_august
inputs.description: Creditors' voluntary liquidations in England and Wales in August 2026, seasonally adjusted as in the headline

provenance.rationale: CVLs have run at roughly 1,500-1,700 per month in recent years and are expected to soften slightly.

inputs.name: compulsory_count_august
inputs.description: Compulsory liquidations in England and Wales in August 2026, seasonally adjusted as in the headline

provenance.rationale: Compulsory liquidations recovered toward about 250-350 per month after HMRC petition activity resumed.

inputs.name: admin_count_august
inputs.description: Administrations in England and Wales in August 2026, seasonally adjusted as in the headline

provenance.rationale: Administrations have averaged roughly 110-150 per month recently.

inputs.name: cva_count_august
inputs.description: Company voluntary arrangements in England and Wales in August 2026, unadjusted as in the headline

provenance.rationale: CVAs are a small residual category, typically around 10-20 per month.

inputs.name: receivership_count_august
inputs.description: Receivership appointments in England and Wales in August 2026, unadjusted as in the headline

provenance.rationale: Receiverships are a very small residual category, typically a handful per month.

inputs.name: august_2025_total
inputs.description: Headline total company insolvencies reported for August 2025

provenance.rationale: Monthly headline totals through 2024-25 sat mostly in the 1,800-2,200 range; August 2025 is placed near 2,000.

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Factor by which the August 2026 headline total grows relative to August 2025

provenance.rationale: Insolvency numbers are expected to be broadly flat to slightly lower as financing conditions ease, but with wide uncertainty.

paths.description: Estimate the 2026 annual company insolvency total, divide by twelve months, and adjust for August seasonality
Sum the five headline component counts expected for August 2026
Scale the August 2025 headline total forward by an assumed year-on-year growth factor
